blocker.detail: O_FEED revision 6 is valid for the last fully compared 179-instance clean wave. At least nine clean worker namespaces produced newer source artifacts after the comparator source snapshot. Those raw deltas must wait for new novelty, evidence-strength and decision-relevance outputs bound to their exact blobs before canonicalization/admission is advanced.

exact_continuation: Re-scan only clean worker/comparator namespaces and capture any remaining post-comparator worker artifacts (two namespaces had no newer artifact in this snapshot). Wait for novelty, evidence-strength and decision-relevance outputs that cover the exact new source blobs. Reconcile aliases/mechanisms, the self_improvement source-lineage discontinuity, contradictory evidence, exact tested scope, provenance and uncertainty only after the complete triplet exists. Reconsider O_FEED from revision 6 without treating omitted prior-feed items as rejected. Never use legacy/pre_independence material as clean input and never write downstream judgments into exploration workers.
